title: THE ARMORY CODEX
why: His yes to suggestion 30. The stash has a new ARMORY button beside SORT. It opens a page that lists every gun in the game, with the rarity each one wears: the eleven models and the rarity twins of the green, blue and purple ones, from common up to gold. A gun you have never held shows as a silhouette marked NOT FOUND with its rarity and class, so you can see what is out there to hunt. A gun you have held shows its name and, once it has kills, its tally. A gun is filed the moment it is in your armoury, stash or backpack, or in your hands or backpack up in a raid, and it stays filed for good. NEW marks what you found since you last closed the page. CLOSE and ESC shut it. Nothing about the guns themselves changes.
now: The stash has an ARMORY page that lists every gun and rarity, found or not.
